output_expectations.notes: Instance API: create HTML input file first, then var options = new HtmlToPdfOptions(); options.AddInput(new FileDataSource('input.html')); options.AddOutput(new FileDataSource('output.pdf')); new Html().Process(options). CRITICAL: Html plugin converts HTML to PDF (NOT PDF to HTML). Input MUST be an HTML file. Create input with System.IO.File.WriteAllText('input.html', htmlContent). Harness-verified: ResultCollection.Count=1, output PDF magic %PDF, size ~110KB.
